newsitem.title: USA: CP&L nuke seen at 100 pct output Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: CP&L nuke seen at 100 pct output Tuesday.

text.p: Carolina Power & Light Co's 683 megawatt Robinson nuclear power unit 2 should reach full output later today, returning from a refueling and maintenance outage, a company spokesman said Tuesday.
"We should be at 100 percent later today," said company spokesman Mike McCracken.
The Harsville, S.C. plant was operating at 89 percent of capacity as of early Tuesday morning, McCracken said.
Robinson 2 was shut Sept 7 for scheduled refueling and maintenance. Restart of the unit was briefly set back on Sunday when it automatically tripped off line due to a valve failure.
CP&L is the sole owner and operator of the Robinson 2 plant.
